chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi visits Elder Master Shen in prison, hoping to uncover the identity of others held in the basement, but receives only a photograph of his mother, which bears an uncanny resemblance to himself. Disturbed by the implication that he might be the original owner of the body, Shen Feizhi prepares to leave using a modified shuttle. Meanwhile, Gu Suizhou decrypts a message from his parents, revealing that they injected a 'defective serum' into Shen Feizhi. Gu Suizhou discovers that the serum was actually used on him during a past illness, and that Shen Feizhi has been quietly gathering medical data to help him, leading to a realization that Shen Feizhi is likely leaving or has already left.
